title: Loop-Count Schedules in Looped Transformers: An Empirical Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.29704v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Looped transformers apply one block of layers several times with shared weights, trading parameters for repeated computation. We study how the schedule of the loop iteration count R during training determines whether each extra pass acts as a full layer or as a small correction, using a controlled ladder of 46M-110M-parameter models trained on 2B tokens with learned residual gates on every loop pass and three schedules: R fixed to 2, R sampled uniformly from {1,...,6}, and R sampled from {2,3,4}. We find that the lower bound of the sampling range is the decisive choice. If the sampled range includes R=1, so that some training steps run the block only once and compute the loss on that single pass, the gates collapse to 0.1-0.5 and each additional pass becomes a small correction to the first; if the range starts at R=2, so that every training step runs the block at least twice, the gates stay at 0.6-0.9 and each pass keeps the strength o

translated_title: 循环Transformer中的循环次数调度：一项实证研究
translated_abstract: 循环Transformer通过共享权重将一个层块重复应用多次，以重复计算换取参数量的减少。我们研究了训练期间循环迭代次数R的调度方式如何决定每次额外的循环是充当一个完整的层还是一个小幅修正。我们使用一组受控的模型阶梯进行实验：46M至110M参数的模型在20亿（2B）token上训练，每次循环配备可学习的残差门控，并采用三种调度方案：R固定为2、R从{1,...,6}中均匀采样、以及R从{2,3,4}中采样。我们发现采样范围的下界是决定性的选择。如果采样范围包含R=1，使得某些训练步骤只运行该层块一次并基于该单次循环计算损失，那么门控值会坍缩至0.1-0.5，每次额外的循环都变成对第一次循环的小幅修正；如果采样范围从R=2开始，使得每个训练步骤至少运行该层块两次，那么门控值保持在0.6-0.9，每次循环都保持完整层的强度。
tldr: 循环Transformer中循环次数采样范围的下界决定了重复计算的性质：若范围包含R=1，门控坍缩至0.1-0.5、后续循环仅作小修正；若从R=2开始，门控保持在0.6-0.9、每次循环均保持完整层的强度。
en_tdlr: In looped transformers, the lower bound of the loop-count sampling range is decisive: including R=1 collapses the residual gates to 0.1-0.5 making extra passes small corrections, while starting from R=2 keeps gates at 0.6-0.9 so each pass retains full-layer strength.
